messages.自分だけで釘を5本以上に保つのは難しいので、釘や狂信を扱うN社の味方と組む。S1: Keeping 5 or more Nails up by herself is difficult, so pair her with N Corp. allies who handle Nails and Fanatic. Stack Nails and Tremor with S1 and S3, then trigger Tremor Burst with S2. Against targets with at least 5 Nails, she can also aim for S3's debuffs. She inflicts plenty of Tremor Count, so she also works as a helper for Tremor attackers who spend Tremor Count.
